title: Provider terminal color consistency review
scope: Agent PTY environment and terminal color rendering across Providers

evidence.observation: Claude is displayed without colors while GPT/Codex still shows colors in the same desktop terminal surface.
evidence.risk: A provider-sensitive terminal environment signal is disabling ANSI color before bytes reach the shared xterm renderer.

evidence.observation: The runtime establishes xterm-256color and truecolor, but the explicit Run environment is merged after the host cleanup step.

decision.terminalEnvironment: Strip accidental host NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR=0 and CLICOLOR=0 signals at the final Agent launch boundary while preserving the shared ANSI/truecolor baseline.
decision.renderer: Keep one xterm palette and one PTY byte path for every Provider; do not add a Claude-only renderer branch.

acceptance: A Claude launch receives the same color-capable terminal baseline as Codex even when the desktop host exports NO_COLOR or CLICOLOR=0.
Explicit non-color signals are not allowed to re-enter through the final launch environment merge.
The existing xterm palette and PTY byte path remain shared across Providers.
